text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—Here, Loves-san.
No one will come to this empty classroom, so we can take our time and talk.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe we shouldn't, Dia-chan.
I can't drag you into this trouble too...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You look so pale and troubled, I can't just leave you alone.
So please... tell me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —About this "cursed video."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I think the rumors started recently.
They say a mysterious video suddenly gets sent to students' smartphones and PCs out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what's in it.
But word is that everyone who watches it meets with terrible misfortune...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
What scares me is how fast the video is spreading.
If it ever reached my precious community members, I just...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see, that certainly is a cause for concern.
Then, if that video really does arrive—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Please bring it to me.
I will watch the video myself.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Why you, Dia-chan?!
That's far too dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Because I believe curses share the exact same structure as jinxes. If you believe it "exists," your heart becomes trapped, and you invite misfortune upon yourself...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I will prove that it "doesn't exist."
Once I do, everyone will stop believing in the curse.
And the jinx—will lose all its power.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Is that really how it works...? In that case, for my community members, I should also—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Buzz, buzz, buzz...)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: N-No way... This email, could it be—
*Haa*, *haa*, *haa*—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what grainy, creepy footage...
Still, we have to look closely... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Did you notice? The scenery, the heavy breathing...
It seems to be footage of someone running on the academy course...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We can't see who it is, but they're incredibly fast...
The one running must be a horse girl of extraordinary skill—
Ah!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That camera shake at the end... Did they fall?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: So it looked like that to you too, right? But are they okay? If someone really collapsed at that kind of speed...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Click*—)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: N-No, no, no, what is it?! A blackout?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...That's strange.
For a simple blackout, even outside the window has gone...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*BANG*... *THUMP-THUMP-THUMP*, *BANG*!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeek!
Who's there?! Don't tell me it really is the curse's—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, Loves-san.
No matter how strange things appear, that does not mean it will "bring misfortune."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It is the believing mind that creates a "curse."
And such a jinx—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —I will break it without fail!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: No way, don't go, Dia-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah—the lights...
Seriously, what was that just now...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
There was no one outside.
However, out in the hallway, for some reason...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: A horseshoe... It looks quite old.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Could it be that the owner wished to run even more...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um, Loves-san.
I have a suggestion. Would you join me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night, someone spotted horse girls running on the training course.
In their hands, for reasons unknown, they held old horseshoes.
